reasoning: The evidence shows that as of early 2026, the SAF maintains firm control of Khartoum. The government officially returned to Khartoum on January 11, 2026, after the SAF recaptured it in March 2024/2025. Multiple sources confirm SAF control with checkpoints and operational presence. The RSF, while conducting drone attacks and maintaining strongholds in Darfur and parts of Kordofan, shows no capability or momentum to retake Khartoum proper by March 31, 2026. Recent RSF activity (January-March 2026) focuses on Kordofan operations, not Khartoum. The SAF is consolidating control and breaking RSF sieges elsewhere. With only ~25 days remaining until the resolution date and no credible reports of RSF advances toward Khartoum, retaking the city appears highly unlikely.
